name: PostgreSQL

description: PostgreSQL database server. Pick the version in the Startup tab before the first start. The superuser password can be changed in the Startup tab at any time.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# The database is created on the first start by the runtime image,
# so it always matches the PostgreSQL version selected in the Startup tab.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Done. The database is created on the first start."

variables.name: Superuser Name
variables.description: Name of the PostgreSQL superuser. Only used when the database is created on the first start.

variables.name: Superuser Password
variables.description: Password of the superuser. It is applied on every start: change it here (not with ALTER USER) and restart the server. Leave it empty before the first start to get a random password in the console.
